typography.scale_note: Irregular ratios: 16 to 20 is 1.25x, 20 to 32 is 1.6x, 32 to 64 is 2.0x

grid.grid_method: flexbox and absolute positioning; CSS Grid count is 0

taste.name: One Claim Owns the First Screen
taste.trigger: When making a globally unknown consultancy legible in two seconds
taste.decision: Spent the entire first viewport on three words at 117px over a full-bleed photograph, over the conventional hero of headline plus subhead plus two buttons plus trust logos
taste.reason: A visitor who cannot say what a company does after one glance leaves; adding a second message to the first screen buys nothing and costs the first one
evidence: midrange 26-36px used 7 times or fewer each
hero is the only left-aligned block on a page that centres its bands

taste.name: The Accent Is a Promise, Not a Decoration
taste.trigger: When a vivid brand teal was available across every section, card and heading
taste.decision: Confined #00B2A4 to button fills alone and built structural colour from two darker teals, over spreading the accent across headings, icons, borders and rules
taste.reason: If the eye-catching colour appears in six non-clickable places it stops meaning click here, and the visitor must read every element to find the action
evidence: #00B2A4 occupies 0.6% of background area, button fill only
#08414D at 9.0% and #0A7580 at 7.4% carry all section banding
buttons are the only 800-weight text on the page

taste.name: Shadows Belong to the Brand's Colour Space
taste.trigger: When cards needed to lift off a white background
taste.decision: Tinted the shadow toward brand teal at 48px blur and -12px spread, over the default grey rgba(0,0,0,0.1) drop shadow every framework ships
taste.reason: A grey shadow on a coloured brand surface reads as a rendering artefact; a shadow carrying the brand hue reads as the object sitting in the same light as everything around it
evidence: rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 0 2px 4px reserved for tight functional depth
shadow hue matches the #08414D heading colour

taste.name: Restraint: Photography Argues Once, Then Gets Out of the Way
taste.trigger: When every section could have been illustrated with stock imagery of plants, engineers and water
taste.decision: Spent the entire photographic budget on one full-bleed hero and rendered everything below in flat colour, line icons and type, over the sector convention of a photograph per section
taste.reason: Stock photography repeated down a page reads as padding and trains the visitor to skip images; used once, a photograph sets the subject and the page can then be read rather than looked at
evidence: only one image renders above thumbnail scale, 1440x1152 hero
remaining rendered images are 35px region flags at 1:1
three feature columns use line icons at 50% radius, not photographs
#FFFFFF holds 74.4% of background area below the hero
